newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end lower, seen soft before expiry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end lower, seen soft before expiry.

text.p: Austrian shares ended marginally in negative territory on Tuesday after a session of subdued trading.
Traders see the market trading with a soft bias until June futures and options expire on Friday and do not expect the ATX index to reclaim the 1,300 point level at expiry.
"The way it looks at the moment we won't close above it (1,300)," said one trader.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips lost 0.35 percent, or 4.58 points, to close at 1,303.39 points with 16 shares falling, four advancing and one unchanged.
The day's leading decliner was Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien, down 3.16 percent at 494 schillings, while insurer EA-Generali led gainers, adding on 2.39 percent to 3,133 schillings.

Flughafen was hit by "aggressive selling" from an international fund, a trader said, on fears its Incentives for Airlines scheme will weigh down its earnings more than expected, and over a longer period than previously reckoned.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index closed 0.38 percent lower at 476.73 points.
The June ATX future fell 8.6 points to 1,304 on turnover of 2,975 lots. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
